description: Telefonía fija residencial is a dataset listed in Uruguayan national open data catalogue (catalogodatos.gub.uy), an open data portal, published or maintained by URSEC. El siguiente conjunto presenta la información sobre las cantidades de líneas telefónicas fijas a nivel residencial. Los datos que se presentan son la serie historica, ordenados por cada departamento de la República Oriental del Uruguay con valores mensuales desde el año 2015 a la fecha. Coverage: Uruguay. The portal files it under the publisher URSEC. Its tags are Líneas residenciales, Líneas telefónicas, Telefonía, Telefonía residencial. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, JSON, XLSX, XML. The portal shows 2026-02-13 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licencia de DAG de Uruguay. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-uy-portal.
